examples.english: On weekends, I go grocery shopping and buy all the ingredients for the week at once.

notes:
{食料品|しょくりょうひん} refers to food products and groceries, typically items purchased at stores for home consumption.

WORD FORMATION:
{食料|しょくりょう} (food/provisions) + {品|ひん} (goods/items)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {食料品|しょくりょうひん}を{買|か}う: to buy groceries
- {食料品|しょくりょうひん}{売|う}り{場|ば}: grocery section (in a store)
- {食料品|しょくりょうひん}{店|てん}: grocery store

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {食品|しょくひん}: food products (broader, includes processed foods)
- {食材|しょくざい}: cooking ingredients
- {生鮮|せいせん}{食品|しょくひん}: fresh foods

In department stores, the {食料品|しょくりょうひん}{売|う}り{場|ば} is typically on the basement floor.
